# FDG3051

> DO add the suffix “Callback” to names of delegates other than those used as event handlers.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.5.2 Names of Common Types. Applies to: System.Delegate.

## How it is checked

- Check: fdg (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: FDG3051
- Automatic fix: not applied automatically (the fix can break callers)
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

Message: Add the suffix 'Callback' to the delegate '{0}', which no event in this assembly uses

FDG3051 reports an externally visible delegate whose name ends with neither 'Callback' nor 'EventHandler' and that no event declared in the same compilation uses. A delegate named '...EventHandler' is left to FDG3050 and FDG3074. Renaming a public delegate changes the public API, so the fix is breaking; FDG3051 has no code fix.
